text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner, here comes Narita 
Brian! Can Narita Brian take it—!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Maya is—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Rraaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Like I'd... let yooouuu!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing amazing amazing☆ What's this!? 
This kind of thrilling Marvelous is 
just...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
At Nakayama at the end of the year, the 
winner of the Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen, 
is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haah... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ha... ah, hahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(What is this?! What is this, what is 
this, what is this?!?!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(My first ever!! Marvelous!! Everyone was 
sparkling and flashing! Gleaming and 
shining—!!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(I wanna feel it☆ I want to feel this 
Marvelousness again—!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy craaaap, what was that race just 
now?! Like... it just gave me chills...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Brian, as expected, compared to last year 
you're... but still! What is this... why 
am I still trembling...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Has Brian-chan... changed? No, is she 
trying to change...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I want to get out there soon too—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haaah... haaah... ...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, Brian-san! What about next time?! 
You'll run with Maya next time too, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I still want it to be Brian-san! I want to 
catch up, I want to surpass her— because 
Brian-san is Maya's sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So even more—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......Do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —I simply run.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That was... a-ma-zing!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It was super-duper-duper amazing☆★ My skin 
was tingling—and my chest kind of hurt, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Brian, Hishi Ama, and Mayano were all 
sparkling marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because it transcended generations? Does 
being in the Senior class mean I'll get to 
meet another marvelous girl like that!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run, I wanna run, I wanna run 
right now!! Is the Osaka Hai next? Right 
now works! Tomorrow is fine too!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see the next Marvelous soon☆ Lots 
and lots of the Marvelous I haven't 
discovered yet★☆★
choice_data_list: ――Next year, let's run as hard as we can!

――Next year, let's run with all we've got, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday seemed greatly stimulated 
by the race against her rivals. Entering 
this race appears to have been the right 
call.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, with a new marvelous encounter, 
the curtain fell on her Classic year—"
